scientific_integrity: A deterministic complete enumeration checks an explicit acyclic integral discrete-Morse matching and a primitive integer cocycle; the integral equivariant conclusion follows from an exact long sequence and symmetry. No infinite-family claim or priority certificate is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only the natural complex of graphs on exactly six labeled vertices with no perfect matching is classified. The nine-sphere nonequivariant homotopy type is prior work, not a novelty claim. A less-indexed equivalent integral symmetry computation might exist. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Integral symmetric-group homology of the six-vertex non-perfect-matching complex
